ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 70-75% of the visible surface, primarily in the central lobe regions, while low-intensity (black) pixels are concentrated along the perimeters and within linear scarring patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located high-intensity white field. Continuous black border along the trailing and leading edges. Significant black radial mottling originating from the peduncle/median notch area. One distinct circular black focal spot is located in the upper-most quadrant of the left lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-point with a clearly defined vertex and steep interior slopes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge, characterized by numerous sharp peaks and narrow valleys of varying pixel depths, isolated against the lighter background of the sky and water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in acute, upward-oriented tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-density clusters of circular, three-dimensional calcified structures (barnacles) mapped to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral field at various diagonal angles, most prominent on the mid-to-outer section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across both lobes and visible parasitic/commensal barnacle colonization on the distal trailing edge tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated circular black pigment spot in the upper-left interior region of the fluke surface.
